messages:
sam: Starting staged rollout now — 8% canary for model v12.3.2 to eu-west during the 12:30 PT change window. Release notes: https://intranet/redwood/releases/v12.3.2 :eyes:

deploy-bot: rollout-id R-5712349999 initiated — targets: eu-west, canary 8%, route: /api/generate, previous-version: v12.3.1

mira: seeing a small uptick in 502s on /api/embeddings from eu-west around 12:37 PT. Not huge but visible on the dashboard.

leo: can you paste the grafana panel? wanted to compare latency tail and error rate.

mira: here —
```
502 rate (eu-west, /api/embeddings): baseline 0.02% -> spike 0.8% at 12:37
p50 latency: 120ms -> 130ms
p99 latency: 480ms -> 980ms
```

jordan: hmm, that p99 jump looks correlated with the new model host pool. Any OOMs in the node logs?

oncall-ryan: checking infra logs now, pulling from the canary subset.

oncall-ryan: found repeated `kvm cache miss` warnings and a couple of KV cache OOMs on gpu-node-eu-5 around 12:36. Not yet full host OOMs but GC thrashing.

sam: thanks. recommendation: pause the incremental rollout at 8% and pin traffic back to v12.3.1 for the problematic route while we investigate cache settings. We should avoid a full rollback until we confirm root cause. Thoughts?

leo: agree with pause + pin. we can keep the canary instances alive for debugging.

jordan: agree. also add a quick note in the release notes that we paused the canary and we suspect kv cache sizing.

sam: ops run to pin (run when ready):
```bash
rwctl rollout pause --id R-5712349999 --reason "kv-cache thrash in eu-west"
rwctl route pin --route /api/embeddings --version v12.3.1 --force
```

deploy-bot: rollout R-5712349999 paused at 8% by sam — reason: kv-cache thrash in eu-west
deploy-bot: route /api/embeddings pinned to v12.3.1 (previous v12.3.1) — active immediately

mira: confirmed 502s falling back to baseline on /api/embeddings within 2 minutes of pin. p99 down to ~200ms.

leo: :thumbsup: good catch. we'll open an infra issue for KV sizing and add a temporary config tweak to the canary hosts.

jordan: will update release notes and add a rollback-ready checklist: how to unpin, how to resume rollout, and who to @ if it regresses.

sam: consensus check — hold at 8% and pin is the plan. react with :thumbsup: to approve, :stop_sign: to request rollback to v12.3.1 across all regions.

mira: :thumbsup:
leo: :thumbsup:
oncall-ryan: :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:

sam: thanks everyone. i'll leave the canary VMs up for debugging and target a diagnostic patch to kv-cache in the next patch release. Will reopen this thread when we have a fix or decide to rollback fully.
